Do not claim its raw starting RNG vectors were newly seed0-reset. Preserve and require unchanged raw Python/NumPy/TorchCPU RNG through strict loading/build/fit.

fitting_scope: Only old restored152/64; full point/control guards from response22 preserved. All donor300 excluded from calibration. Two exact initial WM/norm/xi copies, optimizer initial empty; no inherited Runner/replay/policy warmup.

confirmation.release: New controlled response labels remain sealed except necessary engineering checks until both final1000 weights pinned. Trainer semantic inputs contain no new-test values.
confirmation.primary: All64 common-pre52 normalized pair error (MSE, and sqrt reported).

confirmation.local_candidate_confirmation: Response MSE strictly decreases and pointwise loss does not increase vs matched pointwise-only control. Otherwise report tradeoff/failure. No stable/contact/force/error filtering or hyperparameter/checkpoint selection.

pause_contract: After two first checkpoint100 artifacts are saved, independent serialization/health readback and ETA are saved, Root pauses Goal per user. With background_continue_to_final=True the retained CPU job may continue to1000; Goalpause does not stop it.
run_preconditions: New full152 response run engineering audit and sealed manifest must exist. Root later creates a separately pinned run protocol with same science fields/sources/recipe and only authorization/seal/parent references added. No calibration execution yet.
